title: Evidence: Canon EOS R5 Issues

attachments.platform_description:

A bright spot is visible in the upper-left corner of the screen.
Approximately 3-4mm in diameter.

attachments.title: Photo 2: Settings Screen

submitted_text:
I performed 10 test shots in controlled conditions:
- Average delay from button press to capture: ~0.4 seconds
- Expected delay per Canon specs: <0.05 seconds

For reference, I tested the same scenario on a friend's R5 and got consistent <0.05 second response.

These issues significantly impact professional use:
1. The LCD bright spot affects exposure preview when reviewing dark scenes
2. The shutter lag makes action photography impossible

I purchased this for wedding photography and cannot use it professionally in this condition.
